target_text: Two people walk towards each other. After they meet, the first person hugs the second person with his/her right hand on the left shoulder, and the second person hugs back around the waist with his/her right hand. As a result, the first person softly pats the second person on his/her back with the right hand while the second person pats the first person's waist with his/her right hand.

The first person walks towards the second person and extends his/her right hand first. The second person also extends his/her right hand and they shake hands up and down twice. Then they release each other's hand.
